nodes.label: ClipForge local-first AI video clipping
nodes.rationale: ClipForge processes long recordings locally into short vertical clips without cloud services or accounts.

nodes.label: ClipForge processing pipeline
nodes.rationale: Pipeline progresses queued->inspecting->transcribing->selecting_clips->tracking_speakers->rendering with monotonic progress and local tools.

nodes.label: Local transcription with faster-whisper
nodes.rationale: Uses faster-whisper with word-level timestamps; handles silent/no-audio cases while keeping transcript internal.

nodes.label: LLM clip selection via Ollama
nodes.rationale: Ollama proposes candidate moments over transcript windows; app validates, snaps boundaries, scores deterministically, and deduplicates.

nodes.label: Heuristic speaker tracking and crop planning
nodes.rationale: Samples frames inside candidates, tracks faces, estimates active speaker heuristically, and produces smoothed 9:16 crop plans with explicit fallback states.

nodes.label: Portrait clip rendering with FFmpeg
nodes.rationale: Renders per-clip H.264/AAC MP4s with dynamic crop driven by stored plan and verifies outputs with ffprobe.

nodes.label: API and results experience
nodes.rationale: Exposes job/transcript/clip metadata and streaming file endpoints; UI previews, downloads, and supports cooperative cancellation/deletion.

nodes.label: Local storage and security hardening
nodes.rationale: Uses UUID-derived managed paths under backend/data with path containment checks, disk guards, and startup cleanup.
